interface.hard_bypass: alpha=0 does not load weights, allocate memory, or create graph nodes

transport.input: T maps ColorLM column hidden states into Coder coordinates
transport.output: transpose(T) maps Coder column hidden states back into ColorLM coordinates

moe.paging: exact-top-k-only; cache miss must wait or take the whole block no-op path

target.site_policy: L35 full-token residual station; donor L45 uses island-private state

runtime_gates.stage_2: independent KV memory with sequence copy/remove support
runtime_gates.stage_3: attention + norm + shared expert, forced residual only
runtime_gates.stage_4: exact top-10 expert paging and full MoE
runtime_gates.stage_5: short counterfactual NLL and manual coding trial
